title: Reduced Non-Specific Binding of Super-Resolution DNA-PAINT Markers by Shielded DNA-PAINT Labeling Protocols
authors: Lučinskaitė E; Bokhobza AFE; Stannard A; Meletiou A; Estell C; West S; Di Michele L; Soeller C; Clowsley AH
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA-PAINT超分辨成像中DNA探针的非特异性结合减少方法，虽涉及DNA-DNA互作但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟建模方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The DNA-based single molecule super-resolution imaging approach, DNA-PAINT, can achieve nanometer resolution of single targets. However, the approach can suffer from significant non-specific background signals originating from non-specifically bound DNA-conjugated DNA-PAINT secondary antibodies as shown here. Using dye-modified oligonucleotides the location of DNA-PAINT secondary antibody probes can easily be observed with widefield imaging prior to beginning a super-resolution measurement. This reveals that a substantial proportion of DNA probes can accumulate, non-specifically, within the nucleus, as well as across the cytoplasm, of cells. Here, Shielded DNA-PAINT labeling is introduced, a method using partially or fully double-stranded docking strand sequences, prior to labeling, in buffers with increased ionic strength to greatly reduce non-specific interactions in the nucleus as well as the cytoplasm. This new labeling approach is evaluated against various conditions and it is shown that applying Shielded DNA-PAINT can reduce non-specific events ∼5 fold within the nucleus. This marked reduction in non-specific binding of probes during the labeling procedure is comparable to results obtained with unnatural left-handed DNA albeit at a fraction of the cost. Shielded DNA-PAINT is a straightforward adaption of current DNA-PAINT protocols and enables nanometer precision imaging of nuclear targets with low non-specific background.
abstract_zh: 基于DNA的单分子超分辨成像技术DNA-PAINT能够实现单个靶标的纳米级分辨率。然而，该方法可能受到显著的非特异性背景信号影响，这些信号源自非特异性结合的DNA偶联DNA-PAINT二级抗体，如本文所示。利用染料修饰的寡核苷酸，在开始超分辨测量之前，可以通过宽场成像轻松观察到DNA-PAINT二级抗体探针的位置。这揭示出，相当比例的DNA探针可能非特异性地在细胞核内以及细胞质中积累。本文引入了Shielded DNA-PAINT标记方法，该方法在标记前，于离子强度增加的缓冲液中，使用部分或完全双链的对接链序列，以大幅减少细胞核及细胞质中的非特异性相互作用。这种新的标记方法在不同条件下进行了评估，结果表明，应用Shielded DNA-PAINT可将细胞核内的非特异性事件减少约5倍。标记过程中探针非特异性结合的显著减少，与使用非天然左旋DNA获得的结果相当，但成本仅为后者的一小部分。Shielded DNA-PAINT是对现有DNA-PAINT方案的一种直接改进，能够以低非特异性背景实现核靶标的纳米级精度成像。
